test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'Pamplet'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word among the options is '**Pamplet**' as the correct spelling would be '**Pamphlet**'.
 
• A **pamphlet** is a very thin book with a paper cover containing information about a particular subject.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at the other word meanings;

 
• **Accessories**: an extra item that is added to something and is useful or attractive but not of great importance.
 
• **Dominant**: more powerful, important, or noticeable than others.
 
• **Politician**: a person who holds or is seeking political office as an elected government official.
